subject: Mobile Development
title: The Pegasus Spyware Scandal
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Pegasus Spyware Scandal usable.

hook.text: NSO Group sold spyware to governments that could hack any iPhone or Android silently.

buildup.text: Pegasus could read messages, track location, activate the camera, and record calls.

discovery.text: Investigations revealed Pegasus was used against 50,000 phone numbers including journalists and activists.

twist.text: Apple sued NSO Group. The US government blacklisted the company.

climax.text: Pegasus proved that even the most secure phones can be compromised by nation-state tools.

punchline.text: No phone is safe from a government-grade hack.

quiz.question: What could Pegasus spyware do to a phone?
options: Read messages, track location, and activate the camera
